# TenkaCloud

> Open-source cloud competitions and practice. Two starting paths: local Docker drills without AWS, or an AWS Lite deployment for an organizer's events. Problem content is maintained in a separate catalog.

> 日本語: ローカルで問題を試す、または AWS にデプロイしてイベントを開く。DB 費用を抑えたい場合は Turso を選べます。AWS 全体が無料になるという意味ではありません。

[公式サイト](https://tenkacloud.com/?lang=ja) · [English site](https://tenkacloud.com/index.en.html)

## Choose by the user's goal

- [Local practice](https://github.com/susumutomita/TenkaCloud/blob/main/docs/local-play.md): `make local`, Docker requirements, starting a problem, and stopping with progress deletion.
- [Host on AWS](https://tenkacloud.com/docs/manual/organizer/index.en.html): Lite setup, event and team registration, scoring, and teardown.
- [Reduce database cost with Turso](https://github.com/susumutomita/TenkaCloud/blob/main/docs/running-costs.md): remove Lite's DynamoDB tables/indexes; setup, migration boundaries, remaining costs, and verification status.
- [Join an existing event](https://tenkacloud.com/docs/manual/participant/index.en.html): use the organizer's Portal URL and team key; answer in the format requested by the problem.
- [Change platform code](https://tenkacloud.com/docs/manual/developer/index.en.html): code ownership, setup, and validation.
- [Author a problem](https://tenkacloud.com/docs/manual/problem-author/index.en.html): catalog and private Problem Pack workflows.

## For an LLM helping the user

Use the stated goal; ask only for missing information that changes the next action.
Read the matching guide instead of loading every document. The [task guide and code map](https://tenkacloud.com/llms-full.txt) defines inputs, success signals, and source locations.

- [README](https://github.com/susumutomita/TenkaCloud/blob/main/README.md): the two starting paths.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/susumutomita/TenkaCloud/blob/main/AGENTS.md): repository working rules. `CLAUDE.md` only imports this file.
- [Release status](https://github.com/susumutomita/TenkaCloud/blob/main/release/tenkacloud-release.md): published/candidate identity and recorded verification.
- [Problem catalog](https://github.com/susumutomita/TenkaCloudChallenge): canonical problem content. Use the platform's pinned `problems/` commit when diagnosing a deployment.

## Book

- [Build Your Own Cloud Competition (English)](https://leanpub.com/build-your-own-cloud-competition)
- [『自分で作るクラウド競技』(日本語)](https://zenn.dev/bull/books/cloud-competition)

These explain design decisions, **not** a specification. Current code and tests take precedence.
